title: Read a resource
brief: Open the shop Application for the named environment. Find its Deployment in the tree, then inspect the Desired manifest to see its readiness probe.

checks.question: What is the Deployment named?
checks.hint: Find the Deployment node in the Application tree.
checks.why: The tree shows which resources this Application owns.

checks.question: What path does the Deployment's readiness probe use?
checks.hint: Select the Deployment and open its Desired manifest. Look under readinessProbe.httpGet.
checks.why: The Desired manifest shows the probe Argo will apply.
